title: The training-time law
caption: The iron law's macroscopic product specialized to a training run. O counts only useful model FLOPs; every stall, bubble, and recompute lives in eta. Memory is absent -- it is a feasibility constraint, not a factor.

symbols.name: training time
symbols.meaning: wall-clock duration of the run

symbols.name: operation count
symbols.meaning: useful forward-plus-backward model FLOPs, ~6PD

symbols.name: peak rate
symbols.meaning: hardware peak FLOP/s at the chosen precision

symbols.name: utilization
symbols.meaning: achieved model-FLOP rate over the peak -- the engineering target

title: Training work per token
caption: Each token costs ~2P FLOPs forward and ~4P backward -- six per parameter in all, times the corpus token count. The factor the optimizer cannot change; only data curation or a different algorithm shrinks it.

symbols.name: operation count
symbols.meaning: total useful FLOPs the run must execute

symbols.name: parameters
symbols.meaning: model parameter count

symbols.name: dataset tokens
symbols.meaning: tokens processed across the run

symbols.name: six per param-token
symbols.meaning: 2P forward + 4P backward FLOPs per token

title: Model FLOPs utilization
caption: The per-step estimator of eta_hw: useful model arithmetic over what the peak could have executed in the measured step time. The numerator excludes rematerialization, so a checkpointed run scores lower even at equal speed.

symbols.name: MFU
symbols.meaning: fraction of peak throughput doing useful model work

symbols.name: model FLOPs
symbols.meaning: per-step forward+backward arithmetic, no recompute

symbols.name: peak rate
symbols.meaning: device peak FLOP/s at the run's precision

symbols.name: step time
symbols.meaning: measured wall-clock time per training step

title: The four-term memory budget
caption: Weights, gradients, optimizer state, and saved activations. Under mixed-precision Adam the first three are a fixed 16 B/param; only A grows with batch and sequence, which is the term that pushes a model off one device.

symbols.name: training memory
symbols.meaning: total resident state a step must fit

symbols.name: weights
symbols.meaning: FP16 kernel copy + FP32 master in the standard recipe

symbols.name: gradients
symbols.meaning: per-parameter gradient buffer, FP16 in mixed precision

symbols.name: optimizer state
symbols.meaning: Adam's first + second FP32 moments, 8 B/param

symbols.name: saved activations
symbols.meaning: forward tensors retained for backward; scales with B x S

title: The overlapped step floor
caption: Serial stages cost their sum; correctly overlapped stages cost their maximum. The book's 30+10+50 ms example falls to a 50 ms interval -- overlap removes exposed waits, never the slowest stage itself.

symbols.name: step interval
symbols.meaning: steady-state time between consecutive steps

symbols.name: prepare time
symbols.meaning: host decode/augment/tokenize per batch

symbols.name: transfer time
symbols.meaning: host-to-device copy per batch

symbols.name: compute time
symbols.meaning: device forward+backward+update per batch

title: Optimal checkpoint schedule
caption: Store k segment boundaries and recompute the L/k layers inside each. The minimum lands at k = sqrt(L): 48 layers become ~7 retained checkpoints, ~71% of activations saved for about one extra forward pass.

symbols.name: activation memory
symbols.meaning: retained forward state under the schedule

symbols.name: checkpoint count
symbols.meaning: number of segment boundaries stored

symbols.name: per-layer activation
symbols.meaning: activation bytes one layer retains for backward

symbols.name: layer count
symbols.meaning: network depth

symbols.name: optimal k
symbols.meaning: sqrt(L) -- the memory-minimizing segment count

title: Ring AllReduce per-device volume
caption: Scatter-reduce plus all-gather around a ring. Per-GPU traffic tends to a fixed 2PB as N grows -- set by parameter count, not batch size, which is why splitting a batch raises the unhidden sync share.

symbols.name: sent volume
symbols.meaning: bytes each device transmits per gradient sync

symbols.name: device count
symbols.meaning: replicas in the ring

symbols.name: parameters
symbols.meaning: gradients synchronized, one value per parameter

symbols.name: bytes per gradient
symbols.meaning: gradient element size, 2 B in FP16

symbols.name: ring factor
symbols.meaning: 1.75x for N=8, tending to 2 as N grows

title: Effective batch under accumulation
caption: The batch the optimizer actually sees: micro-batch per accumulation step, times accumulation steps, times data-parallel replicas. Arithmetic per update is unchanged -- accumulation changes the memory shape of the batch, not the math.

symbols.name: effective batch
symbols.meaning: sequences summed into one gradient update

symbols.name: micro-batch
symbols.meaning: resident batch per forward/backward

symbols.name: accumulation steps
symbols.meaning: micro-batches summed before the update

symbols.name: replicas
symbols.meaning: data-parallel devices contributing to the update
